# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.16 (pre-release)

**No macOS binaries in this release.** GitHub assigned no macOS runner on 2026-11-04 (jobs queued 15+ minutes and were cancelled), so the macOS builds were left out. Linux (x86-64, arm64) and Windows binaries are included. macOS users can build from source.

Changes since pre.15 (40 commits). Everything below was run by the author's assistant on one Linux machine; nothing was tried on Windows, macOS, a phone, or with a real hand-verified reference text.

**Command line**
- `--passages-jsonl FILE` (with `--ocr`): one JSON line per OCR paragraph (page, box, hash, citation); `scripts/check-passages.py` validates it.
- `--embed-project` / `--extract-project`: the settings and sources travel inside the PDF and come back byte-identical (round trip checked).
- `--tagged-pdf`: tagged PDF with paragraphs, headings, language and title; self-check script included, PDF/UA conformance **not** validated (no veraPDF here).
- `--integrity-hints`: neutral “to check” marks per page (copy-move detection on by default). Tried on one example only; not a forgery detector.
- `--search-old-orthography` and `--ocr-modern-spelling`: Romanian spellings with î/sînt (1953–1993) mapped to modern forms.
- `--auto-retry`: opt-in retry of doubtful pages. The gate showed no gain, so it is shipped as tested and rejected.
- MCP server now speaks revisions 2024-11-05 and **2026-07-28** (`server/discover`, `resultType`, cache hints, error -32022), chosen per request. Checked with the official Python SDK 2.3.0 client (new era) and the older test client; not tried with Claude Desktop.

**OCR**
- External-engine bridge `scripts/engine-onnx.py` with docTR-family recognisers carrying a retrained Romanian head (ă ș ț). On 12 pages of one magazine against ABBYY-derived text: character error with diacritics 4.26 % vs Tesseract 5.25 % (best 8 pages), but exact word recall 88.2 % vs 91.3 %. Needs onnxruntime and a ~25 MB download (`scripts/get-romanian-doctr-models.sh`). Not the default engine; large-type pages (p21) still fail.
- Several ideas were tested and rejected, with numbers, in ROADMAP 4.22–4.24.
- Capture assistant `web/capture/index.html` (single offline page, auto-shot, burst ZIP).

**Packaging and docs**
- Real `.deb` builder (`packaging/debian/build-deb.sh`); winget, flatpak and AUR recipes revised after an audit (none submitted).
- Dependency update (4 compatible bumps), 0 RustSec advisories hit, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES completed (28 missing crates).
- New audits in `docs/audit/` and an adversarial comparison with current competitors (`docs/ADVERSARIAL-ANALYSIS.md`), including the new ScanTailor FanMode alpha.
- The website no longer claims the built-in engine was validated only on synthetic pages.

**Open before publishing**
- Rights to the scans and the textbook used to fine-tune the built-in model, and to the five hand transcriptions in `docs/experiments/` (see `docs/audit/assets-licences.md`).
- Rust 1.95 build (only the CI `msrv` job can show it), e-Factura CIUS-RO current version, macOS builds (none shipped here).
